race.comment: KEAYANG MINNESOTA (13) has been racking up the wins and made it five in a row when she led and battled on well to score by one metre at Horsham last Sunday. Draws out a little on the second line so may need luck at some point but has won from there before. MEADOW VALLEY STAR (12) was just over 5m off KEAYANG MINNESOTA last time but started 20m behind her in the handicap. Came from a similar barrier for fourth the last time he started behind a mobile. This suits. CARLA PIXIE NZ (9) draws on the second line this time but is worth plenty of thought off a last-start win by 1.1 metres at this circuit and distance. QUAKE PROOF (4) draws well and deserves respect after coming from back row draws for a win and a placing in his last two outings.
